messages:
Priya: Following the DB failover postmortem 141, we need to assign remediation owners and set concrete timelines. Noting a repeat of the same failover sequence twice in the last month.

Cal: I can own the failover instrumentation and alerting work. Will create a Jira and aim for an initial patch + tests by 2025-02-05.

Diego: I'll take the runbook clarifications and the automated chaos test addition. ETA: 2025-02-12.

Priya: Please include RACI fields on the ticket so handoffs are clear. R: Cal, A: Priya, C: Diego, I: infra-oncall. Also add recurrence_count=3.

PagerBot: Created ticket RDX-4120: "DB failover: improve instrumentation and runbook" assigned to Cal. https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RDX-4120

Nina: We should avoid duplicating long-term backlog items. Link RDX-3900 (DB resilience epic) and mark this as a short-term remediation with an explicit acceptance criteria: <5s median failover detection + alerting within 30s.

Cal: Added link to RDX-3900 in RDX-4120. Repro steps and quick PoC logs posted.

Diego: I'll add the chaos test PR template and a small test plan into the ticket comments. Also recommending a canary on one region first.

Priya: Good. Process decision: for postmortem remediations we follow: create ticket within 48h, owner assigned within 72h, runbook + canary plan before rollout. Also a monthly "recurrence review" meeting to look for patterns across postmortems.

Nina: I'll take the dashboard spec for recurrence tracking (failover events / month per service) and have a draft by 2025-02-02.

Cal: Quick Q: Should we split instrumentation and runbook into two tickets? I'm worried scope creep.

Priya: Keep them as subtasks under RDX-4120. Short-term fixes as child tasks so tracking is straightforward.

PagerBot: Reminder scheduled: "Postmortem recurrence review" first run 2025-02-10, attendees: SRE, Platform, PMs.

Diego: I'll coordinate with oncall to validate the alert thresholds during the canary.

Priya: Action recap (copy to RDX-4120 comments):
- Cal (R): instrumentation + alerting PoC, due 2025-02-05
- Diego (R): runbook updates + chaos tests, due 2025-02-12
- Nina (C): recurrence dashboard spec, due 2025-02-02
- Priya (A): validate acceptance criteria & sign-off before full rollout, due 2025-02-15

Cal: Acked. I'll update the RACI fields and attach the PoC logs.

Nina: Draft dashboard posted, will add screenshots and alert links.

Priya: Thanks everyone. Keep comments and status updates on RDX-4120. Ping here if you hit blockers. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
